tei:titleStmt.tei:title: תהלים קי״ח
Psalms 118, an adapted German translation for Hallel by Lisa Tarlau (1909)

tei:div.tei:head: Psalms 118, an adapted German translation for Hallel by Lisa Tarlau (1909)

tei:l.tei:hi: Hodu lAdonai ki tov, ki l’olam ḥasdo.

tei:lg.tei:l: Yes, he is gracious, give thanks aloud to the Lord,
the mighty one, his favor
lasts forever. Israel rejoices
And Aharon’s sons join in with praise,
And all who love the Lord with reverence,
They cry out gratefully from the depths of their hearts:
His favor endures forever! —
In fear and distress I cried out to You, O God,
and You delivered me from my suffering,
Now I feel safe in Your protection
and do not fear the scorn and mockery of men,
the threats of enemies, the insults of the wicked.
For You are with me, in You I trust
And I seek my protection in Your grace.
No prince’s favor and no mighty sword
can ever compare to Your favor and power,
and no love is like Your love,
and no loyalty endures like Your loyalty.
That is why Your name is my standard in battle,
and even if the enemies surrounded me like swarms of bees,
their sting threatening a thousand times,
they had to perish before You, O Lord,
as before the brilliant fire of sharp thorns.
So close to falling, so close to succumbing, —
You were my support and my comfort.
You chastised me, but you did not condemn me,
you wanted me to live
and to proclaim your glory alive;
you were merciful, you were my shield and refuge.
The stone that seemed useless and was spurned
by the builders, You Lord, lifted it up
and by Your grace it became the cornerstone.
It seems like a miracle and yet it has happened,
and it is still happening and our hope shall
never fade away like your help,
and our song of rejoicing shall not fade away
and shall not end; every day of joy,
which you give us, shall always resound anew:
O Lord, help us!
O Lord, make us happy!
O help us, Lord, O Lord, make us happy!
And he who comes in your name, Lord,
Be a dear, most welcome guest to us,
Who finds us ready for your service,
And as we sing our song of thanksgiving today,
So may it always ring out in your praise:

tei:l.tei:hi: Hodu lAdonai ki tov, ki l’olam ḥasdo.

tei:lg.tei:l: Praise be to the Eternal, give thanks to him,
He is all-good, his grace endures forever.
